name: Garruk, Veiled Butcher
description: An Echoverse version of Garruk who donned the Chain Veil in the Onakke Catacombs, summons predators, and works as the Theorist's assassin.

timeline.summary: Tempted by Kothophed, Garruk dons the Chain Veil in the Onakke Catacombs.
timeline.quote: Tempted by the offer, Garruk donned the Chain Veil, an artifact of evil soul-binding magic.

relations.note: Garruk works as the Theorist's assassin.
relations.quote: Garruk leaves a trail of blood and death as he helps the Theorist cleave away the troublesome elements of this new Multiverse.
